Garma-garam Chana Dal Masala ( ) — bharpur ghee, roasted masalon ki khushbu aur dhabe jaisa zabardast flavour! This Dhaba Style Chana Dal Fry and Punjabi Dal Fry is finished with a delicious Dhaba Style Tadka, giving every spoon a rich, creamy taste. Roti ya Rice ke sath ekdam perfect — simple, comforting aur full of flavour!
Preparation time 10 minutes
Cooking time 20-25 minutes
Serving 2-4
Ingredients
For Cooking Dal
2-3 heaped tbsp Ghee, ghi
2 cups Chana Dal (soaked), chana dal
